sys_hub_flow.description: Re-routes an open case when its risk assessment changes after creation: re-evaluates the active routing rules against the current risk/case_type/amount/channel, moves the case to the matched team/group, escalates (never lowers) priority, recomputes the SLA target, notifies the new owning group, and respects an explicit human assignment by logging an advisory recommendation instead of reassigning.
sys_hub_flow.name: bfd_flow_risk_routing
